description: WHEN: a test case failed and the failure must become a Bug in Azure DevOps. Triggers: 'open a bug for this failed test', 'crée le bug depuis le test', 'file the defect'. Builds the Bug from the test case: its steps become the reproduction steps, `observed` is what actually happened, and it is linked (Related) to the test case and to the requirement under test. `observed` must be what was really seen: no personal data. SAFE BY DEFAULT: confirm=false only shows the Bug. Call again with confirm=true after the user agreed. An open Bug with the same title is not duplicated. Needs a PAT with Work Items (Read & write).

confirm.description: false (default): preview only. true: create. Only after the user agreed.

expected.description: Optional: what was expected, if the test case does not say it clearly.

observed.description: What was observed when it failed: the message, the wrong value, the screen.

project.description: Azure DevOps project. Falls back to DEVOPS_PROJECT.

testCaseId.description: Id of the Test Case work item that failed.

title.description: Optional: Bug title. Default: '[Test failed] ' and the test case title.

name: ado_create_bug_from_test
